lines.en: Fatima, guess what? Our book club leader admitted she hadn’t read the whole novel before choosing it.
lines.pt: Fatima, adivinha? A líder do nosso clube do livro admitiu que não tinha lido o romance inteiro antes de escolhê-lo.

lines.en: Seriously? Someone told me she had read it twice and even written the questions for the discussion.
lines.pt: Sério? Alguém me disse que ela tinha lido duas vezes e até escrito as perguntas para a discussão.

lines.en: That is what she claimed. Then she confessed that she had only skimmed the first chapters.
lines.pt: Foi o que ela afirmou. Depois confessou que só tinha folheado os primeiros capítulos.

lines.en: Well, I suggested that we vote on the next book. She promised to let everybody choose.
lines.pt: Bem, eu sugeri que votássemos no próximo livro. Ela prometeu deixar todos escolherem.

lines.en: Good. My neighbour denied that he had said the ending was boring, but several of us had heard him.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Meu vizinho negou que tivesse dito que o final era chato, mas vários de nós o tínhamos ouvido.

lines.en: Typical. I explained that I hadn’t finished the book either, because I had been working late all month.
lines.pt: Típico. Expliquei que eu também não tinha terminado o livro, porque trabalhei até tarde o mês todo.

lines.en: No one blamed you. The owner of the bookshop warned us that the sequel would be out in June.
lines.pt: Ninguém culpou você. A dona da livraria nos avisou que a continuação sairia em junho.

lines.en: Oh, she told me they had already ordered twenty copies. She offered to reserve one for me.
lines.pt: Ah, ela me disse que já tinham encomendado vinte exemplares. Ofereceu-se para reservar um para mim.

lines.en: Then reserve two. I’d like to read it before the meeting, and I will not share mine this time.
lines.pt: Então reserve dois. Quero ler antes da reunião e desta vez não vou emprestar o meu.

lines.en: Fair enough. Remember that last time you said you would lend it to me, and then you forgot.
lines.pt: Justo. Lembre que da última vez você disse que me emprestaria, e depois esqueceu.

lines.en: I apologised, didn’t I? All right, I promise I will bring it on Thursday and I will not forget.
lines.pt: Eu pedi desculpas, não pedi? Tudo bem, prometo que levo na quinta e não vou esquecer.

facts.label: Conversa sobre livros
facts.sub: She admitted she hadn’t read it. He denied that he had said it. I explained that I hadn’t finished. She promised to bring it.

facts.label: admit, confess, deny, claim
facts.sub: Use esses verbos para contar o que alguém disse: She admitted she hadn’t read it. He denied that he had said it. Muitas vezes vêm com that, mas o that pode ser omitido.

facts.label: hadn’t read
facts.sub: Use had/hadn’t + particípio para o que aconteceu antes do momento relatado: She confessed that she had only skimmed the chapters. Em português: “tinha folheado”.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Admitted that she hadn’t read is a reported statement.
After admitted, the verb often goes back one tense.
We say “She suggested me to read”.
items.why: We say She suggested that I read or suggested reading.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Admitted that she hadn’t read is a reported statement. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
After admitted, the verb often goes back one tense. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “She suggested me to read”. → Falso (We say She suggested that I read or suggested reading.)

pages.title: The book club news · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy Wednesday in Dallas. Lena and Fatima meet in a small bookshop. The book club meets here every month. Today the room smells of coffee and paper. Lena has some news to share. They sit by the window and start talking.

“Fatima, guess what? Our book club leader admitted she hadn’t read the whole novel before choosing it.” says Lena. “Seriously? Someone told me she had read it twice and even written the questions for the discussion.” says Fatima. “That is what she claimed. Then she confessed that she had only skimmed the first chapters.” says Lena.
